packageRules.description: Auto-merge minor + patch + pin updates after CI passes (minors added 2026-07-21 once required status checks landed fleet-wide). Dockerfile digest bumps stay manual — a broken base-image digest already broke main once (see commit 513b008). GitHub Actions digests auto-merge after a 7-day release age (rule below); docker-compose digests auto-merge via the rule below.

Auto-merge digest bumps for docker-compose (compose.yaml/docker-compose.yml example pins — docs surface, never executed in CI or production). Dockerfile FROM digests are excluded — those drive every build and have caused breakage before.

Auto-merge GitHub Actions digest bumps once the upstream commit is at least 7 days old. A repointed or compromised tag is normally noticed and reverted within days, and the check a human can do on a SHA (does it match the tag?) is exactly what Renovate already did when it resolved the digest, so waiting is the defence, not the review. chodeus-ops is excluded by the rule below.

Never let Renovate touch a chodeus/chodeus-ops reusable-workflow pin. Those pins are rollout decisions bumped by hand when a shared workflow changes, and Renovate's lagging view of main has already proposed rolling a fresh pin back (appdata.cleanup.ng#7, BeatsCheck#26).
Keep pydantic + pydantic-core in lockstep. pydantic strictly pins pydantic-core in its metadata, so bumping one without the other yields an unresolvable PR.
Docker base images — separate PRs so breakage is isolated
Pin all GitHub Actions to SHAs
